pinExactHint: Check the pin is on your door.
pinCloseHint: This is only close by. Drag the pin onto your salon's door.
searchNotFound: Couldn't find that address. Check the pincode and area, or use your location.
searchUsedUp: You've used your searches for new addresses for now. Try again after {when}, or use your location.

searchTooMany.one: Many address searches in a short time. Try again in {count} minute, or use your location.
searchTooMany.other: Many address searches in a short time. Try again in {count} minutes, or use your location.

searchCheckFields: Check the address, area, city and pincode above, then try again.
searchDown: Address search isn't working right now. Use your location, or try again later.
addressFilled: We filled the address from your location. Check it and correct anything that's wrong.
goneExpired: This request ran out (requests last 7 days). Ask the owner to send it again.
goneClosed: The shop has been closed, so it can no longer be handed over.
goneOwnerChanged: The shop has a different owner now, so this request no longer stands.
goneOther: This hand-over request isn't open any more.
kiranaSoonBody: This app is for salons for now. We'll let you know when kirana shops can use it.
inviteAtTop: Your invitation is at the top of this screen: accept it to join.
noInviteYet: No invitation for this number yet.
welcome: Welcome, {name}. Let's get your salon on Clozest.
closedNotice: {name} is closed. Its upcoming bookings were cancelled and the customers told. You can register a new salon, or delete your account below.
ownSalonBody: Register it in three short steps. Our field team visits, and then customers nearby can book you.
workAtSalonBody: A barber or a helper whose owner already uses Clozest.
askOwnerTitle: Ask your owner to invite you
askOwnerBody: Your owner invites this number in their Clozest Partner app (Team for helpers, or a barber's profile for barbers). The invitation shows on this screen; accept it to join:
tooManyAtOnce: Save at most {max} services at a time: untick {extra}, save, then add the rest.
tickAtLeastOne: Tick at least one service, or add your own.
servicesIntro: Tick what you offer and enter your price. The time is how long to keep the barber's chair for it. Customers who booked it get a reminder to come back after the days shown (0 = never).
needSalonName: Enter the salon name (2 to 100 letters)
needOwnerName: Enter the owner’s name (2 to 100 letters)
needAddressLine: Enter the shop number, building and street
unsaved: Your changes aren’t saved. Leave anyway?
requestAddressIntro: Type the new address and put the pin on the new door. Our field team checks it; until they approve it, customers see your salon at the old address and can book as usual.
ownerNameHint: The salon owner’s name for our records. Your own sign-in name is changed in More.
addressLocked: Your address and pin were verified by our field team, so only they can change them. Moved, or something is wrong? Send them the new one.
locationIntroGpsOnly: Stand inside your salon and tap the button. Customers nearby find you by this pin; our field team checks it on their visit.
locationIntro: Stand inside your salon and tap Use my location, or find it from the address and drag the pin onto your door. Customers nearby find you by this pin; our field team checks it on their visit.
findOnMap: Find my salon on the map
findNeedsFields: Fill in the address, area, city and pincode above to find it on the map.
addressChanged: You changed the address — tap Find my salon on the map again or drag the pin.
locTimeout: That took too long. Turn on GPS and move near the door, then try again.
locUnavailable: Your phone couldn't find its location. Check that location is on.
locUnsupported: This browser can't share a location. Open the app in Chrome or Safari.
dragPin: Drag the pin to your door if it's off.
gpsAccuracy: GPS was accurate to about {metres} m.
pinMoved: Moved {metres} m from the GPS point.
gpsRough: The phone isn't sure where it is. Go near the door or a window, then take it again.
pinInIndia: The pin must be in India.
checkAddressMatches: The pin moved to where you are. Check that the address above still matches it, and change it if not.
needLocation: Add the salon's location to continue.
confirmRecheck: Your trade licence is checked again against the new details: customers see "Licensed" again once it passes, usually within a minute. Your salon stays open for bookings. Tap Save again to go ahead.
sentToFieldTeam: Sent to our field team. Your salon keeps its address until they approve it.
saveAndRecheck: Save and check the licence again
draftExitsAfter: . To delete your account, close it first.
leaveDuringVideo: The salon video is still uploading. Leave anyway? It will have to be sent again.
leaveDuringDocument: The trade licence is still uploading. Leave anyway? It may not be saved.
leaveDuringPhoto: A photo is still uploading. Leave anyway? It may not be saved.
newPhotoRecheck: A new photo or video goes to our field team for a check. Your salon stays live and bookable meanwhile.
yourPhotoHint: A clear photo of your face. Only our field team sees it, to know who to meet.
shopFrontHint: From outside, with the board visible. Customers see this photo.
photosVideoNeeded: Both photos and the salon video are needed.
cutHairQuestion: Do you cut hair here yourself?
youAreBarber: You're one of the barbers: customers can book your chair. Change your services and hours in the Salon tab → Barbers.
barberProfileOff: Your barber profile is switched off, so customers can't book your chair. Switch it on in the Salon tab → Barbers.
onlyStaffCut: Only your staff cut hair. If that changes, add yourself in the Salon tab → Barbers.
cutHairBody: If yes, we'll add you as a barber, so customers can book your chair too. You'll do all your services in the opening hours; change that any time in the Salon tab → Barbers.
reviewPin: Pin on the map (customers find you here)
reviewEditDetails: Edit details or move the pin
servicesHoursReadFailed: Couldn't read your services or hours. {reason}
holidaysBody: Days the whole salon is closed, such as Diwali. You can add more later in the Salon tab → Closed days.
afterSubmit: After you submit, our field team calls and visits to check the salon. Meanwhile you can add your barbers.
sheetBody: After you submit, our field team calls you to fix a time and visits {name}. Customers can book once it's approved.
sheetFixFirst: Something to fix first? Tap Not yet. You can also change details later.
sentBack: Our field team asked for a change: {reason} Fix it, then submit again.
sentBackList: Our field team asked for a change. Fix it, then submit again.
